title: Nice set!
text: Nice set!. I picked these because they'll be sitting near my stove on a copper heat-protective mat, so their copper tops look great!  They'll be to easy to hold, but I'll find out eventually how easy the tops will be to clean.  They hold a reasonable amount of salt and pepper too.

description: This salt and pepper shaker set is made of sturdy, clear glass, with a stainless steel screw lid. The clear glass in combination with the metal lid gives this salt and pepper shaker set a sophisticated, elegant look that is sure to compliment your kitchen. Dishwasher safe, easy to clean, and made with high quality materials. BPA free.
